description: An ALIAS of search_jobs in the fixed shape ChatGPT's deep-research and company-knowledge connectors call: one query string in, {results:[{id,title,url}]} out. Every result's id is the job id fetch and every other tool take; url is the employer's own apply page when the board holds one, else the posting's page on the site. Same board, same ranking, same limit as an unkeyed search_jobs (10 rows); the disclosures ride beside the results. Any other client should call search_jobs, which takes every filter.

query.description: Free text — title, skills, a place, exclusions with a leading minus.

name: search

agenciesExcluded.description: Row-selecting: disclosed agency inventory is hidden from this page.

countUnavailable.description: The board could not count this query exactly — do not report a total.

ignoredFilters.description: Filters the board could NOT apply. Results answer a wider question than was asked.

intentFilters.description: Words read out of the query as filters.

nextOffset.description: Pass back as `offset` for the next page.

id.description: The job id — pass it to fetch, get_job, check_jobs_open.

salaryStatedOnly.description: Row-selecting: this page excludes the ~87% of postings with no stated pay.

total.description: Exact match count. ABSENT with countUnavailable:true when the board refuses to guess.

title: Search (alias of search_jobs, in ChatGPT's research shape)
